# H1
Racesafe VeloAir Air Gilet

# META DESCRIPTION
Racesafe VeloAir Air Gilet: a standalone air gilet certified to NF S72-800:2022, with a gas canister included and a slimline fit that sits over a show jacket.

# SHORT DESCRIPTION
The Racesafe VeloAir Air Gilet is a standalone air gilet and [air vest](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/rider/riding-wear/body-protectors/air-jackets-and-air-vests.html) certified to NF S72-800:2022 that lets you move freely with a close, stretch fit. It can be worn on its own or over one of our [riding body protectors](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/rider/riding-wear/body-protectors.html) if it fits comfortably.

- Type: Air vest
- Airbag coverage: torso, hips and neck when inflated
- CO₂ canister: Included, sized to each jacket
- Wear with: no body protector required underneath
- Certification: NF S72-800:2022
- Freedom of movement: close fit with stretch built in for inflation
- Breathability: water-repellent, breathable outer for all conditions
- Fastening: waterproof zip

# LONG DESCRIPTION
## Safety Standards & Protection Level
The Racesafe VeloAir Air Gilet is certified to NF S72-800:2022, the French standard for equestrian airbag garments. When activated, it inflates in less than 0.095 seconds to cover your torso, hips and neck.

## Riding Use Cases
Racesafe designed the VeloAir Air Gilet for everyday riding. Where the rules require it, wear it over a BETA Level 3 body protector for competition. Always check the current rules of your governing body before competing.

## What You Need
The Racesafe VeloAir Air Gilet arrives with a gas canister, saddle strap, hex key and a smart jacket bag with an integrated hanger. The canister size depends on the jacket size:

| Jacket size | Canister |
| --- | --- |
| YR1 / YR2 | 30g |
| YR3 / A1 | 38g |
| A2 / A3 | 45g |
| A4 / A4T | 55g |

## Sizing & Fit
Eight sizes run from Young Rider 1 to Adult 4 Tall, and an adjustable waistband tailors the fit around you.

| Size | Chest (cm) |
| --- | --- |
| Adult 1 | 86.4-91.4 |

For help choosing a size, visit our store for a free fitting or call our advice line on 01429 864112.

## Colours
The Racesafe VeloAir Air Gilet is available in Black and Midnight Navy.

## About Racesafe & discount-equestrian.co.uk
[Racesafe](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/shop-by-brand/hows-racesafe.html) manufactures at its Northamptonshire factory in Great Britain, where the third generation of the family now runs the business. That British workshop is where the VeloAir is made.

The Racesafe VeloAir Air Gilet is supplied by [discount-equestrian.co.uk](https://www.discount-equestrian.co.uk/), an authorised Racesafe stockist and UK equestrian retailer with 14 years' experience supplying horse riding clothes and horse supplies, specialising in riding body protectors and air jackets. Alongside air jackets, we stock spare CO₂ canisters, lanyards and saddle straps, and 90% of our reviewers recommend us.
